title: T2S billing conceptual model
meaning: System has directed associations to cash-account service and account. Service and account each point to invoice; account points to account identification. Invoice points to line item, then adjustment/product. Product points to price, category, quantity and tax; tax points to country, party and tax record. These arrows belong to the source conceptual model and do not establish chronological billing activities or XML containment.

title: T2S cash-account management conceptual model
meaning: Cash-account and reporting services specialize account service. Cash-account service further generalizes bank operation, debit/credit facility and cash-management service; it connects mandate, while bank operation connects bank transaction and threshold. Contact-point channels specialize into phone, postal and electronic addresses. Account restriction connects a validity period. The displaced ReportingChannel/RelatedReportingService labels are attached to the ContactPoint–ReportingService association, independently confirmed by FullBusinessModel!A1000:F1000 and A3799:F3799. No message direction is implied.

title: T2S collateral-management reference-data conceptual model
meaning: Filled diamonds are retained at the source owner ends: Collateral composes Security and CollateralStatus; Security composes SecuritiesIdentification; SystemPartyRole composes PartyIdentificationInformation. Collateral and SystemPartyRole have a plain association. This records the supplied conceptual notation, without turning composition into database keys, XML containment or institutional ownership.

title: T2S collateral-reporting conceptual model
meaning: The model links system membership and organisation identification to account, account servicing, securities/cash account types and collateral valuation/variation margin. Securities balance connects security, account and quantity. Securities and account identifications link generic identification and scheme; information and identification-issuer roles provide separately scoped identification context. Association labels near SecuritiesPricing and Security refer to different links: Pricing on price/security, IdentifiedSecurity and Identification on security/identification. No payment or reporting message direction is supplied.

title: T2S account-link reference-data conceptual model
meaning: SecuritiesAccount and CashAccount specialize Account. Account has directed composition to account identification and party-identification information. AccountLink has two directed composition associations, one to securities account and one to cash account, each with literal multiplicity 1 at both ends. The filled diamonds remain at Account or AccountLink; the arrowheads remain at the identification or linked-account end. These are source conceptual-model relationships, not inferred XML parentage.

title: T2S party reference-data conceptual model
meaning: Generic identification relates document, status reason, scheme, party identification and information-party role. Scheme, postal address, party identification and system each have separate validity-period relationships. Organisation identification specializes party-identification information, and identification issuer specializes information-party role. PaymentStatus specializes Status. SystemPartyRole links the system; it is a contextual role rather than a fixed institution. The DataSourceScheme label belongs to StatusReason–GenericIdentification, as confirmed by rows 164 and 1525; the Scheme–GenericIdentification link carries Identification (row 159).

title: T2S securities-account reference-data conceptual model
meaning: Account links system, balance, party role and account identification; SecuritiesAccount specializes Account and CashBalance specializes Balance. System, account and information party roles specialize Role; identification issuer specializes information-party role. Account identification uses a generic cost-reference pattern, and generic identification links scheme and party identification. Country links market and postal address. The source’s account role and account entity hierarchies remain separate.
